name: std::ios_base::imbue
intro: Sets the associated locale of the stream to loc. Before returning, each function, registered by register_callback() is called with imbue_event as a parameter.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
loc

 -

 new locale to associate the stream to

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The locale object associated with the stream before the operation.
